title: In silico identi fi cation of novel inhibitors targeting the DNA-binding domain of the human estrogen receptor alpha.
authors: Cao, Huiming; Sun, Yuzhen; Wang, Ling; Pan, Yu; Li, Zhunjie; Liang, Yong
journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接、MD模拟和结合自由能计算，筛选靶向雌激素受体α DNA结合域的小分子抑制剂，干扰其与DNA识别，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: The human estrogen receptor alpha (ERalpha) is an important regulator in breast cancer development and progression. The frequent ERalpha mutations in the ligand-binding domain (LBD) can increase the resistance of antiestrogen drugs, highlighting the need to develop new drugs to target ERalpha-positive breast cancer. In this study, we combined molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations and binding free energy calculations to develop a structure-based virtual screening workflow to identify hit compounds capable of interfering with the recognition of ERalpha by the specific response element of DNA. A druggable pocket on the DNA binding domain (DBD) of ERalpha was identified as the potential binding site. The hits binding modes were further analyzed to reveal the structural characteristics of the DBD-inhibitor complexes. The core structure of the lead molecules was synthesized and was found to inhibit the E2-induced cell proliferation in MCF-7 cell lines. These  fi ndings provide an insight into the structural basis of ligand-ERalpha for alternate sites beyond the LBD-based pocket. The core structure proposed in this study could potentially be used as the lead molecule for further rational optimization of the antiestrogen drug structure with stronger binding of DBD and higher activity.
abstract_zh: 人雌激素受体α（ERalpha）是乳腺癌发生和发展中的重要调控因子。配体结合域（LBD）中频繁出现的ERalpha突变可增加抗雌激素药物的耐药性，凸显了开发靶向ERalpha阳性乳腺癌新药的必要性。本研究结合分子对接、分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算，开发了一种基于结构的虚拟筛选工作流程，以识别能够干扰ERalpha与DNA特异性响应元件识别的命中化合物。在ERalpha的DNA结合域（DBD）上鉴定出一个可成药口袋作为潜在结合位点。进一步分析了命中化合物的结合模式，以揭示DBD-抑制剂复合物的结构特征。合成了先导分子的核心结构，并发现其能抑制MCF-7细胞系中E2诱导的细胞增殖。这些发现为配体-ERalpha在LBD口袋之外的替代位点提供了结构基础见解。本研究中提出的核心结构有望作为先导分子，用于进一步合理优化具有更强DBD结合力和更高活性的抗雌激素药物结构。
